description: Fast automated first-pass code review by ReviewForge. Send source code (Solidity, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or generic) and get a numbered defect list with severity, line numbers, an explanation of each issue, and a concrete fix suggestion. Deterministic static heuristics catch common defect shapes: reentrancy (checks-effects-interactions), hardcoded secrets and private keys, tx.origin auth, eval/exec, SQL string building, empty catch blocks, weak randomness, and more. Runs in about a second. This is a lite heuristic pass, not a substitute for a full manual audit. [PAID: $0.105 USDC per call via x402]

code.description: Source code to review (up to ~60 KB).
